description: Deletes the item at the given 0-based index (question, page break, text block, ...). Deletion shifts every later item one position down — re-check indexes with get_form between successive deletes.

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

index.description: 0-based position of the item to delete (from get_form).

name: delete_item
title: Delete an item
